## Process lead
Called fire-and-forget from `lead-intake` right after it answers the webhook, with `{ lead, config }`. Builds the sheet row and both notification emails from the lead in one Code node, appends the row to the configured Google Sheet, then emails the team and the customer. One webhook call carries one lead, so every cross-node reference here anchors on `.first()`.

nodes.name: Map lead
nodes.notes: Why Code: one tested function builds the sheet row and both notification emails from the same lead, instead of separate Set and expression nodes for each

parameters.content:
## Append row
Appends one row to the configured `Moving leads` tab, auto-mapped by field name from "Row fields"' JSON output. `options.cellFormat: 'RAW'` stores every cell exactly as sent — a phone number never becomes 5.7E+11, and a formula-looking name never runs as a formula — matching the RAW append `tests/workflows.test.ts` pins.

## Notify
Emails the team a plain-text alert (no tel:/mailto: links: is_email allows characters in a local part that could pre-fill a crafted reply) and the customer an HTML summary with their estimate and reference, reply-to set to the team address.
